callouts.text: 1 · Select estimate. In the inspector, the Inputs row is ONE field: frame: Frame. Click it, select all, type   window: int = 5   — watch the Block paint name, type and the = 5 chip as you type
2 · In that same field type   pose: P   — the moment you pass the colon, the board's Types appear (Pose is the Type Block on the left). Enter accepts it.

3 · On the canvas, click the input's name (or its type) — the same one-line editor opens over the port. Press End, type   = None   and Enter. Then type two plain words in it: no suggestions, just a name.

PASS WHEN · There is one text field per port everywhere (inspector row, canvas editor, free Port panel); a colon offers Types, an equals sign offers variables, a bare name offers nothing; and the Block always paints what the line says.
